sentence: Thirteen plaques inside Hangar Six are pinned to an open pillar frame with nothing behind them. This is the thing they are bolted to.

derivation.note: Not a position list. Positions for these 13 already exist and are resolved at runtime; duplicating them here is exactly the class of second source of truth that furniture-placement.js was written to remove. Instead: one backing panel per furniture group whose resolved placement.mode === 'wall', emitted from the same resolver call that placed the plaque.
derivation.rule: for each edge-furniture group in course.ts createTurnMarkers(): const placement = resolveFurniturePlacement(...); if (placement.mode === 'wall') emit a backing panel with the class table below, at the same sample, at backingLateral, with bottomHeight = PLAQUE_BAND_BOTTOM_METRES. H1 raised that constant from 3.2 m to 4.6 m because the chase camera rides a measured 4.09-4.20 m above the deck, so every panel and every plaque moved up 1.4 m with it; the band itself still lives only in furniture-placement.js.

classes.backs: turn chevron plaque, 3.00 x 1.45 m (course.ts chevronBoardWidth / chevronBoardHeight)
braking distance board, 2.465 x 1.28 m (course.ts distanceBoardWidth = 1.7 * 1.45)

placement.note: 0.06 m outboard of the plaque's own halfWidth - 0.35, so the plaque stands proud of its backing by 60 mm. That gap is the whole effect: it is what casts the shadow line the recess on the sheet is drawn to receive.
placement.facing: same as the plaque it backs; one-sided plane, no back face
placement.renderOrder: below the plaque; the plaque keeps its existing renderOrder

deckSafety.note: The panel grows upward only and its bottom edge is flush with the plaque's at exactly PLAQUE_BAND_BOTTOM_METRES; a symmetric margin would hang structure over the deck under the band, the precise P13 failure.
deckSafety.clearsDeck: true, via the overhead-structure branch (bottomHeight >= PLAQUE_BAND_BOTTOM_METRES, 4.6 m since H1)
deckSafety.validatorAction: add the two classes to the enumeration in validate-furniture.mjs as an EDGE class with bottomHeight 4.6 - they must be measured, not exempted.

runtime.shaderModel: MeshLambertMaterial - these are lit surfaces inside a lit shell, not unlit signage

spareSlots.BOLT_PAIR: fixing detail if a future plaque needs a wider panel than PANEL_CHEVRON
spareSlots.MOUNT_STRAP: vertical strap tying a panel to a pillar, for the two placements nearest a frame column
